Panamericana, Nuevo Chimbote' (exp. 201300143694, 04/09/2013). The only PECSA station in Villa María in OSM (node 3646844816 operator=PECSA, brand:wikidata=Q62299262; area way 828895493) stands on the old Panamericana stretch (OSM 'Avenida La Marina' way 1547457512, which continues from PE-1N way 287161074 via 'Avenida Panamericana Sur' way 569451300) at the end of Av. placements.store: Tambo San Juan de Lurigancho - Mz. G
placements.address: Mz. G, Lt. 25, Urb. La Planicie de Canto Grande
placements.method: No defensible point. 'La Planicie (de Canto Grande)' is not in OSM: Nominatim returns nothing in SJL (only Calle La Planicie in Rímac and Wong La Planicie in La Molina). It exists as 'Asociación de Vivienda La Planicie de Canto Grande' (RUC 20269554593, fiscal address 'Mza. J Lote 01 A.V. La Planicie', SJL — no street). The only locational lead is an Enel outage notice listing 'Urb. Canto Rey, Av. El Parque cdra. 5 Mz. D, Asoc. La Planicie de Canto Grande Mz. E, F, H, J, Asoc. Pro Viv. Garagay Mz. D' in one block; OSM has Av. Canto Rey (way 549418674, -11.97706,-76.99876) and a 'Canto Rey' bus stop on Av. Fernando Wiesse (Urb. San Rafael) but no 'Urb. Canto Rey', 'Av. El Parque' (SJL, that area) or 'Garagay' feature, so an outage co-listing cannot fix a point. The report's nearby unmatched OSM row osm-n5591615727 is NOT this store: it is a bare 'Tambo' shop=convenience node, version 2, last edited 2021-12-14 (before this July 2026 opening), 37 m from Tiendas 3A Canto Grande 24, whose official address is 'U.I. Elizabeth, Comuna 9, Mz C Lote 22' (not La Planicie).
evidence: https://www.peru-retail.com/tambo-inaugura-16-nuevas-tiendas-y-queda-cerca-de-alcanzar-los-900-locales-a-nivel-nacional/ (2026-08-14: 'San Juan de Lurigancho (2): Av. Los Jardines Este 587 y Mz. G, Lt. 25, Urb. La Planicie de Canto Grande')

placements.store: Tambo San Martín de Porres - Mz. B
placements.address: Mz. B, Lt. 15, Asoc. Los Olivos de San Vicente
placements.method: No defensible point. 'Asoc. Los Olivos de San Vicente' is not in OSM (Nominatim: no match; only an unrelated Calle San Vicente in Chuquitanta and San Vicente Ferrer schools in Los Olivos district). The only lead is a Pluz outage notice for 25/09/2026 (SMP/Callao, 8:00-18:00) listing 'Asoc. Los Olivos de San Vicente Mzs. A, B, C, D, E' among ~25 associations of the Santa Rosa–Oquendo area (Jardines de Sta. Rosa III, La Alborada de Sta. Rosa, Sta. María del Valle III, San Valentín, San Remo III, Las Gardenias de Oquendo, La Floresta de Oquendo, Villas de Oquendo, ...): that places it somewhere along the SMP/Callao border near Oquendo, an area of several km² — too broad for a point. Not found in the Callao cadastral plan (CERCADO-CALLAO-2020.pdf).
evidence: https://www.peru-retail.com/tambo-inaugura-20-nuevas-tiendas-y-supera-las-900-a-nivel-nacional-donde-estan-sus-nuevos-locales/ (2026-09-09: 'San Martín de Porres (2): Av. Alfredo Mendiola 900, Urb. Palao y Mz. B, Lt. 15, Asoc. Los Olivos de San Vicente')

https://elcomercio.pe/respuestas/a-que-hora/anuncian-corte-de-luz-este-sabado-26-de-setiembre-revisa-los-horarios-y-zonas-afectadas-tdpe-noticia/ (Pluz outage 25/09/2026, SMP/Callao: '... ASOC. LOS OLIVOS DE SAN VICENTE MZS. A, B, C, D, E ...' with Santa Rosa / Oquendo associations)
Nominatim (2026-10-01): 'Los Olivos de San Vicente, San Martín de Porres', 'Olivos de San Vicente' (global and SMP viewbox), 'San Vicente' SMP viewbox → no association
https://www.municallao.gob.pe/portal-anterior/pdf/obras/mapas/maps/CERCADO-CALLAO-2020.pdf (text layer searched: no 'San Vicente')

placements.noteEs: Sin ubicación: la Asoc. Los Olivos de San Vicente no figura en OSM ni en Nominatim; un aviso de corte de luz de Pluz (25/09/2026) la incluye entre asociaciones de la zona Santa Rosa–Oquendo (límite SMP/Callao), zona demasiado amplia para ubicar la tienda. Ubicar a mano.
